controls.name: 4096: Manage HSDL Spreadsheets Templates and Load Data using HSDL
controls.description: Detects unauthorized access or elevated role privileges permitting the creation and execution of HSDL data loading templates.

controls.name: 4078: Manage Employee Work Relationship and Payroll Definition
controls.description: Monitors segregation of duties conflicts between employee assignment modifications and payroll run authorizations.

controls.name: 4079: General Ledger Journal Creation and Posting Segregation
controls.description: Enforces strict Segregation of Duties between creating journal entries and approving or posting them to the ledger.

controls.name: 4080: Accounts Payable Invoice Creation and Payment Approval
controls.description: Identifies identities possessing concurrent privileges for invoice entry and supplier payment approval.

controls.name: 4081: Manage Purchase Order and Receive Goods Segregation
controls.description: Prevents buyers who generate purchase orders from recording corresponding inventory goods receipt confirmations.

controls.name: 4082: Fixed Asset Additions and Asset Depreciation Overwrite
controls.description: Surveillance on asset capitalizations, retirement transactions, and manual depreciation calculation overrides.

controls.name: 4083: Bank Statement Reconciliation and Payment Execution
controls.description: Monitors segregation boundaries between electronic funds transfer release and general ledger bank reconciliation.

controls.name: 4084: Manage Supplier Bank Accounts and Supplier Site Creation
controls.description: Audits modifications to supplier bank accounts, routing codes, and site procurement authorization limits.

controls.name: 4085: Manage Customer Credit Limit and Approve Sales Orders
controls.description: Prevents customer credit line modifications from being approved by the sales rep managing the order entry.

controls.name: 4086: Maintain Item Master and Issue Inventory Adjustments
controls.description: Identifies inventory warehouse specialists with concurrent authority to create item definitions and post scrap adjustments.

controls.name: 4087: Human Resources Compensation Plan and Salary Grade Updates
controls.description: Monitors compensation management privileges to ensure separation from individual employee grade modification.

controls.name: 4088: User Provisioning and Security Privilege Assignment
controls.description: Surveillance on IT Security Manager assignments and creation of administrative security profiles in Security Console.

controls.name: 4089: Manage Tax Calculation Rules and Tax Rate Overrides
controls.description: Prevents tax configuration rule administrators from executing invoice tax rate overrides on AP or AR documents.

controls.name: 4097: Manage Payroll Flow Patterns and Submit Payroll Runs
controls.description: Enforces separation between editing payroll calculation formulas and triggering monthly payroll disbursement cycles.

controls.name: 4098: Enter Expense Reports and Audit Expense Reimbursements
controls.description: Surveillance on corporate card expense submissions and audit approvals performed by the same cost center owner.

controls.name: 4099: Manage Project Budget and Approve Project Transactions
controls.description: Segregates project baseline budget authorization from project expenditure and invoice approval duties.

controls.name: 4100: Maintain Cost Accounting Distributions and Run Cost Allocations
controls.description: Monitors cost distribution accounting adjustments against automated manufacturing cost center allocations.

controls.name: 4101: Manage Cash Management Internal Transfers and Wire Approvals
controls.description: Enforces dual authorization between internal pool bank transfers and external commercial wire transfers.

controls.name: 4102: Enter Customer Receipts and Write Off Accounts Receivable
controls.description: Prevents accounts receivable clerks from executing credit adjustments or bad debt write-offs on open balances.

controls.name: 4103: Enter Requisitions and Approve Purchase Requisitions
controls.description: Detects self-approval of procurement requisitions or bypass of supervisory expenditure approval hierarchy.

controls.name: 4104: Manage Contract Terms and Execute Commercial Agreements
controls.description: Ensures legal contract clauses modification is strictly separated from procurement execution authority.

controls.name: 4105: Segregation of Duties: AP Invoice Creation and Payment Disbursement
controls.description: Prevents identities with invoice creation privileges from holding payment release or bank account disbursement duties.

controls.name: 4106: Manage Performance Evaluation and Rating Adjustments
controls.description: Audits supervisory override of annual employee appraisal scores and calibration committee results.

controls.name: 4107: Manage Benefit Enrollment Plans and Life Event Approvals
controls.description: Monitors manual life event adjustments triggering unauthorized health or pension benefit plan enrollments.

controls.name: 4108: Define Chart of Accounts and Maintain Account Hierarchies
controls.description: Prevents General Ledger accounting users from altering chart of accounts structure, segment values, or rollup trees.

controls.name: 4109: Maintain Inventory Physical Counts and Post Cycle Count Adjustments
controls.description: Enforces separation between conducting physical warehouse counts and posting book value variance adjustments.

controls.name: 4110: Manage Time Card Submissions and Time Card Approvals
controls.description: Detects self-approval of overtime or hourly time card submissions across operational project assignments.

controls.name: 4111: Manage Electronic Bank File Transmission Profiles
controls.description: Surveillance on modifications to ISO 20022 and BAI2 electronic banking transmission endpoints and encryption keys.

controls.name: 4112: Define Automated Accounting Rules and Override SLA Mapping
controls.description: Prevents Subledger Accounting (SLA) journal derivation rules from being manipulated without GRC change approval.

controls.name: 4113: Execute Mass Salary Increases and Mass Updates to Employment Records
controls.description: Monitors batch execution of HCM mass action salary increases and retrospective grade reclassifications.

controls.name: 4114: Manage Procurement Catalogs and Agreement Price Overrides
controls.description: Segregates master supplier contract price negotiation from blanket purchase agreement line pricing release.

controls.name: 4115: Manage Billing Transactions and Issue Credit Memos
controls.description: Surveillance on customer invoice generation and unauthorized credit memo issuance without manager delegation.

controls.name: 4116: Maintain Intercompany Balancing Rules and Reconciliations
controls.description: Monitors intercompany balancing clearing accounts, netting arrangements, and cross-ledger elimination entries.

controls.name: 4118: General Ledger Journal Entry and Posting Segregation
controls.description: Enforces separation between journal entry preparation and manual journal posting to GL accounts.
